tagline: Leading provider of analytical instruments and software solutions for laboratory and scientific analysis
hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue and services constitute a key pillar of growth, with an increase of 7% in 2025 for services and 12% for chemistry consumables, reflecting strong customer demand for precision analytical solutions and instrument services.

kpis.name: Recurring revenue and services
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from sales of services and precision chemistry consumables
kpis.description: Recurring revenue represents a significant portion of company revenue, including services and precision chemistry consumables. In 2025, service revenue increased 7% and chemistry consumables sales grew 12%.
kpis.signal: Growth in recurring revenue and services

kpis.name: Consolidated gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin calculated as (Total net sales - Cost of sales) / Total net sales
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key profitability indicator for the company, reflecting operational efficiency despite pricing impacts and labor cost increases.

kpis.name: Consolidated total revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total net revenue of the company including all segments and geographies
kpis.description: Total revenue is a key indicator of company growth, reflecting demand for analytical instruments and consumables. In 2025, growth was supported by strong customer demand for Waters and TA products.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development spending as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.description: R&D spending is a key indicator of company innovation and product development, maintaining a stable proportion of revenue.
kpis.signal: Stability of R&D spending as a percentage of revenue

kpis.name: Capital investments (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for property, equipment and capitalized software
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect investment in production infrastructure and IT systems. The 20% decline in 2025 is due to completion of the company's new manufacturing facilities.
kpis.signal: Decline in capital expenditures following completion of new facilities
